BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Schoesler, Boehnke, Dozier, Holy, J. Wilson, Salomon, Warnick, and Wagoner
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning vacancies on boards of county commissioners.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vacancies on boards of county commissioners; and repealing RCW 36.32.070 and 36.32.0558.

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:

BillSection.P: 2RCW 36.32.0558 (Five-member commissions—Vacancies) and 2015 c 53 s 64, 2003 c 238 s 2, & 1990 c 252 s 6.
